title: Buchtel vs. East — Football (2025–2026)
summary: Buchtel vs. East — 2025–2026 high school football game coverage in Akron, Ohio. Photography by Mason Bybee.
article_headline: Buchtel vs. East: An Akron Football Photo Story
article_dek: A field-level look at the Griffins and Dragons from the 2025 football season.
article_body:
Buchtel and East represent two well-known Akron high school football communities. When the teams share a field, the players and their supporters bring the city’s sporting identity to the same stage.

This photographic archive captures the athletes and game-night energy through Mason Bybee’s sideline images. No specific score is attached because a verified game result has not been matched to this gallery.
